opening.argument: The recording is presented as an effort to occupy a purported Apple-support caller, with the stated aim that every minute spent on the phone is a minute unavailable for targeting someone else. The caller identifies himself as Apple support, claims overseas account access, asks how many devices are connected, instructs the participant to turn on a computer, and directs them to type a web address. Those actions are attributed to the recorded caller, not the video creator. The support-themed graphic matches the subject of the call, displaying “Apple Support” and “Contact Us for Help,” but it does not establish official Apple affiliation, what the destination does, or any resulting data, payment, or account outcome.

citations.quote: every minute you keep these guys on the phone is one minute they're not scamming someone who may actually be falling for it.
Thank you for calling Apple support. This is John.
